name: Makurdi
registryAssessment: A local/provincial custodian is evidenced: Benue Geographic Information System (BENGIS), a Benue State Government service agency operating from the Ministry of Lands, Survey and Solid Minerals service centre in Makurdi. Its public portal documents digital mapping and land services, but no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was established; registryFound remains null.

queries.result: The local-language query did not surface a separate local-language cadastral map or anonymous parcel API. English-language official BENGIS results were the relevant first-party sources; Benue's listed major languages include Tiv, Idoma, Igede, and English, and no reliable Tiv/Idoma cadastral search phrase was established.

officialSources.role: Benue State Government BENGIS public site
officialSources.observation: Identifies BENGIS as a state-owned geospatial and land-service agency and advertises digital mapping, land administration, surveying, and an Explore Map entry, but the reviewed public content did not expose parcel features or a public API schema.
Public page is a sign-in screen with email/phone, password, and verification image. No login, registration, CAPTCHA bypass, credential, or private-token attempt was made.

Directs applicants to the BENGIS Service Centre at the Ministry of Lands, Survey and Solid Minerals on Beach Road, Makurdi; says survey reports are vetted by the Cadastral Unit and plotted/saved into the system. It does not publish parcel geometry or schema.
Describes parcel survey as a licensed-surveyor process subject to Surveyor-General authorization; no anonymous map/API response is provided.
Includes ground-rent fees for Makurdi Urban Area, confirming local service scope; no parcel features or native identity field are exposed.
